label: No infinite SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 series, from the PER_SE_5 regress
meaning: Non-transcription conditional derivation on one q.3 a.4 profile p, one here-and-now efficient causing relation and one PER_SE_5 per se link AsCaused. If there is no infinite chain of PER_SE_5 actual causes of being (ea251340) and every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is a PER_SE_5 actual cause of being (the restated bridge), then no per se series of present efficient causes of being goes on to infinity (the SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 sibling of 97f5850f). With esseRegressOfActualGroundingWFWeak (#1942) and the strength relation ed411e36 (fd12ad3d to ea251340) it carries well-founded actual grounding (82cfaf26) to the secunda via's per se premise on the existential sense: that sense joins the one dependence order. It does not reach 97f5850f (secundaSplitLimit, attached to the argument from e8664ab8 and the sense inclusion). perSeEsseSeriesControls give, for each input, a Bool interpretation in which the other holds and the conclusion fails, and a nonvacuous one. Facts about these interpretations only. The conclusion is not attributed to Aquinas.
